Text_lang: a band of high elven exiles has remained safe
and hidden upon their flying sanctuary of Zephras Isle.
shared a bond with air elementals
who kept their island aloft in the realm of Skywall.
the elementals vanished without a trace--
disrupting the delicate magic that kept them safe in their haven amongst the clouds.
Now, a new generation of Skyborne elves face a time of unprecedented change,
and must seek new allies and sources of magic--
to protect their hidden home and secure their future...
